import sys
import xlrd

book = xlrd.open_workbook(sys.argv[1], on_demand=True)
sheet = book.sheet_by_name("RAW DATA")

sample_ids = []
for col in range(1, sheet.ncols):
    value = sheet.cell_value(1, col)
    if value is None or str(value).strip() == "":
        continue
    sample_ids.append(str(value).strip())

features = []
for row in range(2, sheet.nrows):
    name = sheet.cell_value(row, 0)
    if name is None or str(name).strip() == "":
        continue
    features.append((row, str(name).strip()))

def cell_text(cell):
    if cell.ctype in (xlrd.XL_CELL_EMPTY, xlrd.XL_CELL_BLANK):
        return "NA"
    if cell.ctype == xlrd.XL_CELL_NUMBER:
        return repr(float(cell.value))
    return str(cell.value).strip() if str(cell.value).strip() else "NA"

with open("data_matrix.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as out:
    out.write("id\t" + "\t".join(sample_ids) + "\n")
    for row, feature in features:
        values = [cell_text(sheet.cell(row, col)) for col in range(1, sheet.ncols)]
        out.write(feature + "\t" + "\t".join(values) + "\n")

with open("sample_metadata.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as out:
    out.write("id\tgroup\n")
    for sample in sample_ids:
        group = "patient" if sample.startswith("P_") else "control" if sample.startswith("C_") else "unknown"
        out.write(sample + "\t" + group + "\n")

with open("variable_metadata.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as out:
    out.write("id\tmiRNA\n")
    for _, feature in features:
        out.write(feature + "\t" + feature + "\n")
